assets.name: Shoulder Boulder
assets.scale_status: Suggested art-direction bounds, not measurements of the image. All are visible dimensions above nominal ground; any buried skirt is extra.
assets.silhouette: Squat, broad asymmetric boulder with a sloping top.
assets.features: One broad upper plane and a deliberate shallow front-left groove.
assets.collision_recommendation: One low-complexity convex proxy; ignore decorative shallow grooves.
assets.modeling_notes: The groove must not split the asset into two unrelated stones. Add an unseen closed underside and a short buried skirt.
assets.pivot: At ground contact center, Z=0; root flare/rocks may extend a small skirt below ground.
assets.coordinates: +X right, +Y rearward from the front reference, +Z up; meters. Export conversion is engine-specific.

variation.note: These are suggested placement ranges. Keep silhouette proportions; do not freely randomize nonuniform scale. Check tree lean, rock notch direction, and camera visibility.

assets.name: Split Fin
assets.scale_status: Suggested art-direction bounds, not measurements of the image. All are visible dimensions above nominal ground; any buried skirt is extra.
assets.silhouette: Tall narrow wedge with a forked upper silhouette.
assets.features: An off-center notch extending downward from the top; solid connected base.
assets.collision_recommendation: Two or three simple convex pieces; preserve a visible gap only if it affects gameplay.
assets.modeling_notes: Model a single continuous base. The notch ends above ground, around mid-height. Choose a fixed front/notch orientation and reconcile the lower views to it.
assets.pivot: At ground contact center, Z=0; root flare/rocks may extend a small skirt below ground.

assets.name: Terrace Stack
assets.scale_status: Suggested art-direction bounds, not measurements of the image. All are visible dimensions above nominal ground; any buried skirt is extra.
assets.silhouette: Wide, low outcrop with three clear steps.
assets.features: Three interlocking ledges forming one stable outcrop.
separate_parts: rock_body or three interlocking ledge meshes
assets.collision_recommendation: A few convex volumes following the ledges.
assets.modeling_notes: Ledges rise front to back. They are set dressing unless the level intentionally makes them drivable; collision then needs a separate driving-surface pass. Avoid tiny cracks in the silhouette.
